description: Takes one Gmail message out of Trash. Takes the message ID. Returns the message ID and the labels the message carries afterwards. A message Gmail has already deleted from Trash is gone and answers as not found.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

message_id.description: The ID of the message to take out of Trash.

name: gws-mcp__gmail_untrash
